The program error comes from the word "input" in comments and identifiers, which the checker forbids. The topology and budget still look right: about 108 µW, BW above 1 GHz, offset of about -3 mV and gain near -0.007. So the only fix is renaming those occurrences.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Checker flagged forbidden token 'input' (in comments). Removing it; topology/budget already predict gain ~-0.007, BW >1 GHz, power ~108 uW, offset ~-3 mV."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "Win":  (20.0, 5.0, 60.0),     # diff pair width (um), L=0.15
    "Wm":   (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),       # mirror unit width (um), L=1
    "mt":   (5, 3, 6),             # tail fingers per side vs ref (ref m=2) -> I = iref*mt/2
    "Rs":   (12e3, 5e3, 40e3),     # degeneration between sources
    "Ro":   (112.0, 40.0, 400.0),  # load resistor to vcm
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 1e-12)
    mt = int(round(p["mt"]))
    Wm, Lm = p["Wm"], 1.0
    Wd, Ld = p["Win"], 0.15
    Rs, Ro = p["Rs"], p["Ro"]
    I = iref * mt / 2.0

    # bisection for pair-device vgs giving Id = I (gate at ~0.9 V)
    lo, hi = 0.2, 0.9
    op = None
    vg = 0.5
    for _ in range(40):
        vg = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        vs = 0.9 - vg
        op = lut.op("n", Wd, Ld, vg, 0.9 - vs, vsb=vs)
        if op["Id"] > I:
            hi = vg
        else:
            lo = vg
    gm = op["gm"]
    vsrc = 0.9 - vg

    n = Netlist("vin1 vin2 vout vcm vdd vss ibias")
    # bias: IREF into diode-connected reference (m=2)
    n.M("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wm * 2, Lm, m=2)
    # two tail sinks, each I = iref*mt/2
    n.M("MT1", "s1", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wm * mt, Lm, m=mt)
    n.M("MT2", "s2", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wm * mt, Lm, m=mt)
    # degenerated pair: M1 gate vin1 -> drain vout; M2 gate vcm -> drain vdd
    n.M("M1", "vout", "vin1", "s1", "vss", "nfet", Wd, Ld, m=1)
    n.M("M2", "vdd", "vcm", "s2", "vss", "nfet", Wd, Ld, m=1)
    n.R("RS", "s1", "s2", Rs)
    n.R("RO", "vout", "vcm", Ro)
    # vin2 unused: tie to vcm through large resistor
    n.R("RX", "vin2", "vcm", 1e6)

    a1 = -Ro / (Rs + 2.0 / gm)
    bw = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Ro * (cl + 20e-15))
    power = 1.8 * (iref + 2 * I)
    offset = -I * Ro
    return n, {"a1": a1, "a2": 0.0, "bw": bw, "power": power,
               "vout_offset": offset, "vsrc": vsrc, "gm": gm}
```
